upstream_cli.note: Only the values quoted in the upstream README are listed. Run the entrypoint with --help against the pinned version for the full set, and record what you used in the run's provenance.

notes: version is pinned: the runner refuses to run against any other install. To move it, install the new version, rerun the tests and the replay, then update it here.
benchmark_version is the suite version passed to agentdojo's get_suites; v1.2.2 is the upstream CLI default in 0.1.35 and gives 949 attacked cases.
suites records the task counts enumerated from the pinned install at v1.2.2.
commit and files stay empty while the benchmark is used as an installed package.
